title: Distinguishes current progress and capacity readings
goal: Selects the correct element for the task in progress and the measurements within a given range.
summary: The upload progress progresses with the task, and the storage usage is a current reading in a fixed range. Both look like bar indicators.
tasks: Change #upload to progress, write value to 6, and write max to 10.
Change #capacity to meter, range 0 to 100, current value 65, keep two labels.

example.code:
<label for="done">checked</label><progress id="done" value="3" max="8">3 / 8</progress>
<label for="level">power</label><meter id="level" value="70" min="0" max="100">70%</meter>
example.note: progress indicates an ongoing task. meter represents a reading with a known range.

hint: Look at the meaning of the labels and decide which one is the task progress.
